items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: Him and Red Happy and Black Benny and a few more of them, you know. Just jive singing.

ctx.x: Did he sing when he was young?

No, at that time, you know, he jived around. Some of him and the boys around, they walked around for D.A. Liberty, little quartets. Him and Red Happy and Black Benny and a few more of them, you know. Just jive singing. Kids, you know, like they were doing the street jazz.
Where was Nick of Themis from here, my band?

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Red Happy played with O'Rell Wilde, with King Oliver, I remember Wilde.

ctx.x: Do you remember Red Happy was supposed to be with Oliver sometime? Red Happy. Did you know?
Was he and I do? Red Happy, yeah. Red Happy played with O'Rell Wilde, with King Oliver, I remember Wilde.
What about Ernest Rogers? Was he playing?
